_metadata.title: EuroHPC Federation Platform
_metadata.description: Demo preset featuring the EuroHPC JU supercomputing infrastructure with 10 hosting entities operating petascale and pre-exascale systems across Europe. Includes sample allocations for research projects with various partitions (CPU, GPU, Development, Regular access modes).

customers.name: Barcelona Supercomputing Center
customers.description: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center hosts MareNostrum 5, a pre-exascale supercomputer with ACC, GPP, and HBM partitions. The system undergoes periodic maintenance for storage stability and power infrastructure.

customers.name: CINECA
customers.description: CINECA operates Leonardo, featuring BOOSTER and DCGP partitions with NVIDIA GPUs. Regular maintenance windows for system software updates and facility operations.

customers.name: CSC – IT Center for Science
customers.description: CSC operates LUMI, the most powerful supercomputer in Europe, with GPU and CPU partitions. Located in Kajaani, Finland, with scheduled maintenance for software upgrades and facility operations.

customers.name: IT4Innovations National Supercomputing Center
customers.description: IT4Innovations operates Karolina with CPU and GPU partitions. Maintenance typically focuses on network infrastructure and storage configuration updates.

customers.name: IZUM
customers.description: IZUM operates Vega supercomputer with CPU and GPU partitions. Regular seasonal maintenance windows for system updates.

customers.name: Jülich Supercomputing Centre
customers.description: Jülich Supercomputing Centre operates JUPITER, one of Europe's first exascale systems, with Booster partition featuring advanced GPU acceleration.

customers.name: EuroHPC JU Review Portal
customers.description: Central portal for EuroHPC JU allocation review and project management.

customers.name: LuxProvide
customers.description: LuxProvide operates MeluXina with CPU, GPU, and FPGA partitions. Known for minimal-downtime rolling maintenance approach for OS and storage updates.

customers.name: Minho Advanced Computing Center
customers.description: MACC operates Deucalion with CPU ARM, CPU X86, and GPU partitions. Located in Portugal with infrastructure for hybrid computing architectures.

customers.name: National Academic Infrastructure for Super­computing in Sweden
customers.description: NAISS operates Arrhenius supercomputer providing computing resources for Swedish and European research communities.

customers.name: Sofia Tech Park
customers.description: Sofia Tech Park operates Discoverer with CPU and GPU partitions. Scheduled maintenance for electrical system and infrastructure updates.

maintenance_announcements.name: LUMI Software Stack Update
maintenance_announcements.message: Scheduled software stack update including compiler toolchains, MPI libraries, and system modules. Users should recompile applications after maintenance.

maintenance_announcements.name: Leonardo Workload Manager Update
maintenance_announcements.message: Update to the SLURM workload manager with improved scheduling algorithms and bug fixes. Brief queue drain required.

maintenance_announcements.name: Vega Spring Maintenance Window
maintenance_announcements.message: Annual spring maintenance including firmware updates, storage system checks, and cooling system inspection.
maintenance_announcements.internal_notes: Part of regular seasonal maintenance schedule

maintenance_announcements.name: Karolina Network Infrastructure Update
maintenance_announcements.message: Network switch firmware update and InfiniBand fabric optimization. Some partitions may experience brief connectivity interruptions.

maintenance_announcements.name: Discoverer Facility Maintenance
maintenance_announcements.message: Scheduled facility maintenance for electrical system inspection and UPS testing. Full system shutdown required.

maintenance_announcements.name: MeluXina Rolling OS Update
maintenance_announcements.message: Rolling operating system security patches. Minimal impact expected as updates are applied to compute nodes in batches.
maintenance_announcements.internal_notes: Using rolling update procedure to minimize downtime

maintenance_announcements.name: Deucalion Storage System Update
maintenance_announcements.message: Parallel filesystem software update and performance tuning. Storage access will be unavailable during the maintenance window.

maintenance_announcements.name: MareNostrum5 Storage Optimization
maintenance_announcements.message: GPFS filesystem maintenance and quota system optimization. Read-only access during part of the window.

maintenance_announcements.name: LUMI Facility Power System Test
maintenance_announcements.message: Scheduled datacenter power system testing. Backup power systems will be engaged during the test period.

maintenance_announcements.name: Vega Autumn Maintenance
maintenance_announcements.message: Annual autumn maintenance including system health checks, cooling system preparation, and firmware updates.

maintenance_announcements.name: MeluXina Storage Controller Update
maintenance_announcements.message: DDN storage controller firmware update. Brief I/O pause expected during failover.

maintenance_announcements.name: Leonardo GPU Driver Update
maintenance_announcements.message: NVIDIA GPU driver update for improved performance and bug fixes. GPU partitions will be unavailable.
